cash_tip: The Kapital Bank ATM in town was reported to have cash on Thursday afternoon, so try it first, and choose 'decline conversion' so you're charged in pesos. With the weekend crowds, take out enough at once to last through Monday, and keep small bills handy for tacos, taxis and the market.
